The grant-journal supersession is now complete against the recorded bounds: I re-ran the phrase sweep at this HEAD and it still returns exactly two source dispositions, and both are now cited, digest-pinned, and named in proposedSupersession.of. coordinatorNote: No blockers. That is a real change from v1 and v2, and I want it stated plainly: the substantive architecture questions this row has been failing on — the unassigned grant journal, the missed contrary bounds, the unidentified sole writers, the omitted trust store, the overstated apply path — are all now answered, and I could not break any of them. All four are edits to existing fields, none requires re-deciding anything, and I would expect a v4 to clear them without touching a single architectural position. I did not read the other current v3 reviewer, did not edit the subject, file 08, or COORDINATOR-DECISIONS.md, did not apply SUP-124-GRANT-JOURNAL, did not mint a D-096 (A) grant, and did not commit.
